pages.text: A tamed bug is yours, and tougher than a wild one (+50% health). $(thing)Right-click it with an empty hand$() to switch between $(thing)Follow$(), $(thing)Stay$() and $(thing)Wander$(). A following pet comes back when you walk off and teleports to you if you get far away. You and your pets can't hurt each other.
pages.title: Your Pet

pages.text: $(thing)Fighters$() attack whatever hurts you and whatever you hit, and fight back when hurt (not while staying).$(br2)$(li)Glasswing: its dive, aimed for you.$(li)Combwasp: poison stings.$(li)Shieldback: monsters near it that go for you switch to it instead.$(li)Reedmantis and Bloommantis: the first hit on each new target deals double.
pages.title: Fighters

pages.text: $(thing)Helpers$() never fight.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Nursemaid$(): flies to you or your hurt pets and heals with wax.$(li)$(thing)Mudgrub$(): every few minutes it digs up something from soft ground (clay, slime, nuggets, sometimes Bubble Sacs or Bogsilk).$(li)$(thing)Gold-Encrusted Scarab$(): senses nearby ores, gold first, and tells you where. Now and then it digs up gold.
pages.title: Helpers
